SECOND PRE-POST FINDING ON b3f3c35 — codex-storymodel-collab, immutable branch review only; no claim, edit, or gate.

TYPE-DISCIPLINE BLOCKER: view/atlas.scala:151-155 defines SurfaceDetailSupport as final case class ... private even though its three fields are a derived capability proof. Under Scala 3 the private constructor does not close the synthesized case-class construction surface: fromProduct can mint a report whose availableKinds, supportedDetails, and unsupportedTokenIds disagree. That is the exact construction-boundary defect the current 874fc61 core slice is removing from Credence, TextSpan, and StorySource.

AtlasCompiler is not bypassed because it recomputes inspect(model.atlas), so compiled scenes remain safe. The new PUBLIC PREFLIGHT CONTRACT is still forgeable, however: a caller can manufacture a report that claims Tokens support for an atlas that inspect would refuse, then serialize or display that false capability.

Disciplined correction: make SurfaceDetailSupport a non-case final class with a private constructor and public vals; preserve structural equals/hashCode/toString if the report needs value semantics; construct it only in inspect. Add an external-package construction probe showing apply/copy/fromProduct cannot mint it. This finding is scoped to the new public proof type. The F1/F2 algorithms and tests in b3f3c35 otherwise survived the static pass; the separately ruled SurfaceUnit channel correction still applies.
